name: Kitsuvo
tagline: Browse websites and inspect local site-detection evidence
description: Connect Cline to your own Kitsuvo browser using OAuth and Streamable HTTP. Browse, snapshot pages, and inspect site-detection evidence. Requires Kitsuvo installed on Windows or macOS and an explicitly connected local browser; the relay cannot browse while your computer is disconnected. Sensitive sign-in pages are refused. See the setup guide before authorizing.

install.notes: Install Kitsuvo and start the local cloud connector first. https://github.com/leancoderkavy/kitsuvo-integrations/blob/main/docs/quickstart/cloud-relay.md explains CONNECT and per-client APPROVE. Connection state is ephemeral; reauthorize after relay restart.
